description:
The `--dry-run` CLI option allows users to preview benchmark configuration without
execution. This critical feature is not accessible from the interactive wizard.

When implemented, dry-run mode should:
1. Be offered as an option after configuration is complete (Step 5)
2. Generate a comprehensive summary of what WOULD be executed
3. Show estimated resources (memory, disk, time)
4. Display the equivalent CLI command for future use
5. Preview data generation file sizes
6. Show query list and expected phases

This is critical because new users using the interactive wizard have no way to
validate their configuration before committing to a potentially long-running
benchmark execution.
